findings.text: Lookup service accepts array handle plus start position and upper bound plus optional mark selector and reports located entry while advancing caller index. When selector denotes known mark the marked search path applies otherwise plain forward search applies, with transparent retry after concurrent modification.

Cursor oriented search operations advance supplied traversal state toward next occupied slot inside inclusive upper bound. Plain variant returns next present entry while filtered variant returns next entry carrying chosen mark, both signalling exhaustion by cursor sentinel and null result.

Mark management service allows setting, clearing and bulk initialization of per position indicators through traversal cursor. Initialization establishes free tracking indicator where array requests it and clears all other indicators.

Identifier allocator offers first occupied identifier query inside caller range plus single identifier release plus whole allocator teardown with disposal of attached bitmap storage. Range query translates identifier bounds to chunk positions and scans resident value or bitmap payload for earliest set bit.

Diagnostic helpers emit human oriented description of array nodes, index intervals and identifier allocator contents. Node description covers linkage, geometry, occupancy counters and per mark bitmaps while allocator walk distinguishes absent slots, internal nodes, compact values and full bitmaps.

Compression support offers construction and disposal of multilevel prefix decoding structures plus decoding of one compressed block using literal and distance tables. Construction consumes code length list and base plus extension tables and yields entry tables tuned to caller supplied lookup width.

Mark state remains coherent across levels: asserting indicator propagates toward root until ancestor already asserted, withdrawing indicator propagates only while current level lacks any remaining asserted child, and top level aggregate mirrors global presence. Presence test on node consults emptiness of chunk wide bitset for requested indicator.

Traversal cursor keeps index and level offset mutually consistent using node shift and chunk geometry. Offset derivation masks index by level width while index update preserves higher bits and inserts supplied chunk position; single step helper advances both together.

Search logic treats absent slots and internal redirection placeholders as non reportable, except free mark search may consider absent slots when array tracks vacancy. Special zero encoding normalizes to null before further classification, and sibling redirections cause offset adjustment rather than result.

Array lookup runs under read side critical section with automatic restart on concurrent structural change, releasing protection only after stable result or definitive miss. Retry predicate reevaluates cursor state against returned entry before exit.

Identifier allocator serializes chunk lookup, release and teardown with interrupt saving exclusive protection around array access. Range query holds protection only while locating resident chunk then releases before scanning bits, while release and teardown retain protection across mutation and storage disposal.

Decoding table element pairs two narrow unsigned descriptors with variant payload. First descriptor encodes supplementary width or control action, second encodes consumed input width, payload carries either plain symbol or copy base value or link to subordinate table.

Internal node as observed through diagnostics carries parent linkage plus positional offset, geometric shift, occupancy and value counters, slot storage, sibling linkage and per indicator bitmap matrix. Identifier allocator nests such nodes above either compact integer payloads or full bitmap structures indexed by scaled chunk position.

Plain forward scan progresses through invalid, empty, restart, aligned descent and sibling skipping conditions toward either reportable entry or bounded exhaustion. Chunk overflow climbs to parent with incremented sibling position; disappearance of parent denotes completed walk.

Filtered scan adds top level handling, directional advance flag and chunk wide mark search to plain walk. Cursor beyond upper bound or wrap past limit moves to restart sentinel with null outcome, while root without internal node resolves directly from global mark aggregate.

Block decoder alternates between literal emission and length distance copy until terminal symbol encountered. Literal path appends decoded byte to sliding history with periodic flush on window fill; match path resolves length then distance using respective tables plus caller supplied extension bits before copying from history.

Table construction reports four outcomes encoded as 0 for complete success, 1 for structurally incomplete yet usable tables, 2 for rejected input due to empty or oversubscribed length set, and 3 for resource exhaustion. Successful chain links tables for later sequential release starting from most recent link.

Primary external entry points for this lane are array wide search and identifier allocator query plus release and teardown. Array search requires initialized array and caller owned index variable; allocator calls require initialized allocator and validated numeric range or identifier.

Releasing unallocated, out of range or already cleared identifier triggers diagnostic warning without state change. Range query rejects negative lower bound with EINVAL status and clamps negative upper bound to implementation maximum, reporting ENOENT status when no occupied bit exists inside interval or when chunk position exceeds bound.

Search routines defend against invalid cursor, error state and start beyond limit by immediate bounded termination. Filtered scan explicitly guards index wrap near maximum representable value when advancing to later chunk position.

Compressed input path detects truncated stream and illegal prefix codes during literal, length and distance phases. Bit accumulator requests additional octets on demand and abandons block with error status when source exhausted or when decoder encounters reserved control value.

Table construction validates null input and oversubscription before allocation and unwinds partially linked tables when later allocation fails. Global usage counter accumulates allocated table volume while separate pointer and count variables track transient scratch lifetime.
Maximum prefix length equals 16 and maximum code population equals 288. Default lookup widths equal 9 for literal group and 6 for distance group.

Fixed decoding metadata comprises permutation of 19 entries for length symbol order, base extents and extension widths for upper literal group, plus base offsets and extension widths for distance group. Extension tables use value 99 as sentinel for invalid combinations while compact value path uses machine word width for bit capacity.

Bit accumulator pairs global word buffer with occupancy count plus 17 entry mask table spanning zero to 16 set bits. Output position aliases shared counter while history alias denotes sliding storage and flush helper records position then drains window.

Identifier chunk shift derives from binary logarithm of per chunk bit capacity, establishing scaling between array index and identifier space. Diagnostic walk scales index by per chunk capacity when reporting node ranges and distinguishes value payloads by machine word bit width.

Build and debug controls are inert placeholders in this configuration: static and init qualifiers expand to nothing, debug hooks discard arguments, and module carries version identifier string for provenance.
